sql.select: SELECT photo_id, acquired_utc_seconds, expires_utc_seconds, weapon_id, shield_id, accessory_id, location_id, photo_variant_id FROM album_photos ORDER BY acquired_utc_seconds, photo_id;
sql.delete: DELETE FROM album_photos WHERE photo_id IN ( SELECT photo_id FROM album_photos ORDER BY acquired_utc_seconds, photo_id LIMIT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM album_photos) > @maximum_count THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM album_photos) - @maximum_count ELSE 0 END );
